cohort: The cohort consisted of 2079 pregnant women attending antenatal care in primary health centres in southern Ethiopia.
finding: The study found that 52.3% of pregnant women reported traumatic life events, with 5.1% meeting criteria for PTSD, and women with PTSD had a significantly increased prevalence of IPV and lower satisfaction with antenatal care.
cross-section timing: During antenatal care attendance in pregnancy.
